scripts.build:app: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$key = (Get-Content src-tauri/zqp-updater.key -Raw).Trim(); $env:TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY = $key; $env:TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PASSWORD = ''; npx tauri build; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path release; Copy-Item 'src-tauri/target/release/bundle/nsis/*_0.1.0_*.exe' -Destination 'release/ZQP-Quiz-Generator-Setup.exe' -Force; Copy-Item 'src-tauri/target/release/bundle/nsis/*_0.1.0_*.sig' -Destination 'release/ZQP-Quiz-Generator-Setup.exe.sig' -Force; Copy-Item 'src-tauri/target/release/app.exe' -Destination 'release/ZQP-Quiz-Generator.exe' -Force"
